title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 The Oracle Health
 **Medication Administration** 
 team is responsible for delivering solutions that help clinicians safely and efficiently administer medications across acute, ambulatory, and specialty care settings. Medication administration is one of the most critical moments in the care delivery process, directly impacting patient safety, clinical outcomes, regulatory compliance, operational efficiency, and clinician experience.
   

  

 Our mission is to support and evolve medication administration workflows through intuitive, reliable, and highly integrated solutions that reduce cognitive burden, streamline nursing workflows, and improve patient safety. This includes maintaining existing medication administration capabilities that customers depend on today, while also modernizing traditional workflows through interoperability, mobile experiences, barcode medication administration, clinical decision support, workflow optimization, and emerging AI\-enabled capabilities.
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Senior Product Manager** 
 to help manage, enhance, and modernize medication administration capabilities within Oracle Health’s Electronic Health Record. In this role, you will balance support for existing and legacy product capabilities with the development of new workflows, modernization initiatives, and future\-state medication administration experiences.
   

  

 You will partner closely with nursing leaders, pharmacists, physicians, customers, engineering teams, UX designers, clinical informaticists, quality, regulatory, consulting, and customer\-facing teams to deliver solutions that improve the safety, efficiency, usability, and reliability of medication administration workflows.
   

  

 You will be responsible for understanding customer needs, defining product requirements, prioritizing investments, supporting roadmap execution, and guiding product development from concept through delivery and adoption. This role requires a product manager who can operate across current\-state product support, customer commitments, regulatory and safety expectations, technical modernization, and future\-state product innovation.
   

  

 Your work will directly impact clinicians caring for patients every day while helping Oracle Health advance the next generation of medication management.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Product Strategy, Roadmap, and Portfolio Execution: Contribute to the strategic direction and roadmap for medication administration capabilities across the Oracle Health platform. Balance enhancement requests, customer commitments, regulatory needs, technical debt, customer feedback, defects, lifecycle considerations, and modernization investments across both existing and future\-state product capabilities.
* Existing Product Support and Lifecycle Management: Support the ongoing evolution of existing and legacy medication administration capabilities that are currently used by Oracle Health customers. Evaluate customer issues, workflow gaps, adoption barriers, technical constraints, and lifecycle needs to inform prioritization, sustainment decisions, modernization plans, and customer communication.
* Product Requirements and Feature Definition: Translate customer needs, clinical workflow requirements, regulatory expectations, modernization priorities, and market opportunities into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflow documentation. Partner closely with engineering and UX teams throughout the development lifecycle to ensure requirements are actionable, testable, and aligned to product intent.
* Clinical Workflow Expertise: Develop deep understanding of medication administration workflows, including barcode medication administration, medication scanning, medication scheduling, infusion management, documentation, exception handling, medication safety checks, and clinical communication. Ensure solutions align with real\-world nursing practice across both current customer workflows and future\-state product experiences.
* Customer and User Engagement: Engage with customers, external stakeholders, and internal stakeholders to understand workflow challenges, ensure product capabilities align with customer needs, gather feedback, and support adoption. Act as the voice of the customer while balancing individual customer needs with scalable product direction.
* Patient Safety and Quality Focus: Champion patient safety by identifying opportunities to reduce medication errors, improve compliance with medication administration policies, strengthen documentation quality, and enhance decision support during medication administration workflows. Ensure product decisions appropriately account for clinical risk, usability, reliability, and safety in high\-stakes care settings.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineering, UX, clinical informatics, interoperability, quality assurance, regulatory, consulting, support, customer success, and customer\-facing teams to deliver high\-quality solutions that meet customer and market needs. Drive alignment across stakeholders when priorities, ownership, dependencies, or tradeoffs are unclear.
* Workflow Modernization and Innovation: Drive modernization initiatives focused on improving usability, mobility, automation, workflow efficiency, and product scalability. Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI and intelligent automation, to identify opportunities that create measurable value for clinicians while maintaining trust, safety, and operational readiness.
* Regulatory and Compliance Alignment: Ensure product capabilities support applicable healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, medication safety practices, privacy, security, and documentation requirements. Partner with regulatory, quality, clinical safety, and engineering stakeholders to ensure both existing and new capabilities remain aligned with evolving compliance expectations.
* Product Delivery, Release Readiness, and Adoption: Support release planning, dependency tracking, customer readiness, documentation, training, enablement, and adoption strategies. Measure outcomes and continuously improve products based on customer feedback, support trends, usage data, workflow observations, and product performance metrics.
* Market and Industry Awareness: Maintain awareness of healthcare industry trends, nursing informatics practices, medication safety initiatives, competitor offerings, interoperability standards, and evolving technology expectations. Use market and customer insights to inform roadmap decisions, modernization priorities, and investment recommendations.


**Qualifications**
 Career Level \- IC3
   

  

**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options.  We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.
   

  

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
   

  

 Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**EY Technology:**
 Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.

* Client Technology (CT) \- focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology\-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit\-for\-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.

 This role leads the strategic vision and roadmap for a technical product or products within a specific business area, demonstrating a deep understanding of the product(s). Products may have enterprise\-wide implications. This role also uses market insights to evaluate product functionality and informs the future product direction based on consumer trends and product performance.

* Collaborates with cross\-functional teams to create best practices that drive significant change to the client experience.
* Coaches’ technical product teams towards best practices and learnings. Ensures delivery of messaging, communication, and customer outreach as necessary.
* Partners with stakeholders to resolve production and implementation issues in a timely manner, and supports/drives escalations where required to enable rapid delivery.
* Leads the planning, development and implementation of new technical products. Defines and analyzes technical markets, developing detailed product features and requirements, and developing implementation plans.
* Employs a variety of qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve the user experience.
* Participates in and provides recommendations for ongoing business planning and departmental prioritization activities.
* Participates in the team’s engineering practices in development, continuous integration, and automated deployment.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.

title: Staff Product Manager
description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.
   

  

  

  

***There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.***
  

  

  

 At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise\-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people\-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S\&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And, over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.
   

  

  

  

***Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.***



**Job Description**

**Role Overview**




 As a Staff Product Manager (IC4\) on the IT Service Management (ITSM) product team, you will serve as a principal individual contributor and domain expert driving the next era of enterprise service delivery. This role is designed for a strategic product leader who combines deep technical depth in enterprise IT workflows with the learning agility required to navigate rapidly shifting market dynamics. Sitting at the strategic nexus of Design, Engineering, Product Marketing, and Customer Success, you will act as a high\-impact cross\-functional leader. You will define and execute an ambitious product vision—continuously refining it based on customer empathy, AI\-driven automation, and real\-time operational feedback. If you possess a relentless drive to master complex domain ecosystems, inspire cross\-functional teams without authority, and transform enterprise IT friction into modern, effortless user experiences, this role offers an expansive platform for your craft.
   

  





**The Impact You Can Create**



* **Pioneer Bold Innovation:** 
 Drive market\-defining ITSM features from concept to production, leveraging thought leadership to keep our enterprise platform at the bleeding edge of intelligent service management.
* **Orchestrate Cross\-Functional Success:** 
 Build aligned, high\-velocity team ecosystems where Engineering, UX, Sales, and GTM teams execute in lockstep to achieve aggressive revenue, adoption, and customer retention targets.
* **Deliver Global Scale \& Value:** 
 Continuously analyze user telemetry and enterprise landscapes to deploy intuitive, low\-friction capabilities that eliminate critical operational bottlenecks for global IT teams.
* **Demystify Complex Architectures:** 
 Deconstruct intricate ITSM backend workflows, ITIL frameworks, and integration layers into clean, scalable technical requirements—accelerating developer velocity and minimizing execution risk.



**Roles \& Responsibilities (R\&R)**




**1\. Vision, Strategy \& Strategy Adaptation**



* Own the long\-term product vision and multi\-year strategy for our ITSM capabilities, seamlessly integrating market research, user behavioral data, and emerging technology trends into an actionable roadmap.
* Maintain an agile, high\-conviction roadmap capable of fluidly adapting to shifting enterprise priorities, competitive shifts, and technical discoveries without losing strategic momentum.
* Demonstrate bold thought leadership by challenging legacy ITSM paradigms and introducing modern, self\-service, and AI\-first product paradigms.



**2\. Requirements Definition \& Lifecycle Management**



* Lead the end\-to\-end product lifecycle—from initial problem discovery and UX journey mapping to detailed PRDs, roadmap prioritization, and feature rollout.
* Translate complex IT operational workflows, service desk mechanics, and routing logic into exceptionally clear, developer\-ready technical requirements.
* Maintain daily operational execution standards across engineering squads, driving high velocity in a fast\-paced release environment.



**3\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Stakeholder Alignment**



* Partner intimately with UX Design and Engineering to co\-author elegant, accessible solutions tailored for both IT administrators and end\-users.
* Serve as the primary communications bridge across the business, keeping internal partners (Design, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Leadership) and external stakeholders aligned on delivery timelines and strategic value.
* Drive alignment across executive and cross\-functional leadership through transparent, data\-backed product narratives and clear ROI justification.



**4\. Customer Advocacy \& Co\-Creation**



* Partner directly with enterprise IT leaders, sysadmins, and end\-users to prioritize critical pain points, map high\-impact themes, and co\-design solution workflows.
* Cultivate deep user empathy to convert complex service desk friction into intuitive, consumer\-grade product experiences.



**Skills \& Core Competencies**




**Adaptability \& Learning Agility**



* **Ecosystem Fluidity:** 
 A proven ability to rapidly deconstruct, master, and stay ahead of evolving ITSM frameworks, API ecosystems, and modern enterprise IT infrastructure.
* **Resilience in Motion:** 
 High comfort reprioritizing strategies and roadmaps mid\-cycle in response to new data, technical constraints, or shifting market demands.
* **Problem\-Solving Rigor:** 
 Exceptional analytical capabilities to break down ambiguous, multi\-layered enterprise problems into structured, iterative release phases.



**Cross\-Functional \& Human Capabilities**



* **Inclusive Communication:** 
 Superior written and verbal communication skills, with a natural ability to translate complex technical architecture into clear executive business value, and vice versa.
* **Matrix Influence:** 
 Demonstrated capability to guide, align, and inspire distributed, cross\-functional software teams without direct organizational authority.
* **Active Listening:** 
 High empathy and active listening skills to accurately surface the underlying operational needs of enterprise customers and internal stakeholders.



**Technical \& Domain Expertise**



* **Product Development Mastery:** 
 End\-to\-end fluency across both technical and business layers of SaaS product delivery—from telemetry\-driven prioritization to go\-to\-market positioning.
* **ITSM Specialization:** 
 Comprehensive understanding of modern IT Service Management workflows—including Incident, Problem, Change, and Asset Management, Service Catalog, and AI\-assisted Service Desk automation.


**Qualifications**

**Qualifications \& Experience**



* **Educational Foundation:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience coupled with a track record of continuous technical growth).
* **Product Leadership:** 
 9\+ years of dedicated SaaS product management experience, demonstrating progressive ownership of complex enterprise software products.
* **SaaS Industry Native:** 
 5\+ years of experience operating within the fast\-scaling, iterative execution cycles of the B2B SaaS industry.
* **Domain Depth:** 
 3\+ years specifically managing products explicitly built for IT or developer teams, with deep exposure to ITSM, ITOM, Service Desk, or workflow automation platforms.
* **Fast\-Paced Delivery:** 
 Documented track record of repeatedly shipping high\-impact software capabilities within rapid release environments while making rigorous data\-driven decisions that balance near\-term execution with long\-term platform health.


**Additional Information**

 At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
 **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

title: Product Lead - Financial Reporting
description:
Arcesium is a financial technology and professional services firm, delivering solutions to some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions, including hedge funds, banks, and institutional asset managers.  Building on a platform developed and tested by one of the world’s leading investment and technology development firms, the D. E. Shaw group, Arcesium launched as an independent company in 2015\. Morgan made a strategic investment in the company.  We are looking for an exceptionally talented individual to join the Product Management Group in our Hyderabad, Bengaluru or Gurgaon office. * Proficiency in Excel along with strong analytical skills to mine counterparty statements
* Experience in working closely with engineering teams
* Outstanding academic background \& passion to work in a high\-tech software development environment
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
* Critical thinking and the ability to articulate standpoints/ideas and influence stakeholders
* Ability to multitask and manage multiple lines of execution with attention to detail and quality
* A high level of personal maturity and a collaborative attitude
* A healthy combination of resourcefulness, domain expertise, creativity and execution prowess

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Senior Consultant-TS-AI Strategy
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Strategy \& Transactions \- SFL Scientific– AI Strategy ( Senior Consultant)**
 At Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions (S\&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth. SFL Scientific is part of Deloitte’s AI strategy, data science, and engineering practice. We help clients move beyond pilots by shaping enterprise AI ambition, prioritizing high\-value use cases, designing AI operating models and governance, and partnering with technical teams to scale AI solutions that deliver measurable business value.
   

  

 We serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data\-driven choices, using the state\-of\-the\-art technologies, to advise our clients on how to leverage AI technologies and working directly with them to design , implement and scale novel solutions that drive value.
   

  

 But we don’t stop at client impact. We are equally passionate about investing in our people. In S\&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands\-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. You'll have the opportunity to work across industries, engage directly with senior client stakeholders, and develop expertise at the intersection of strategy, AI, and business transformation.
   

  

 If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real\-world impact and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ Strategy \& Transactions is your next move.
   

  

**The team**
* Our Strategy practice brings together business strategists, AI specialists, data scientists, engineers, and transformation advisors to help clients move from AI ambition to measurable enterprise value. We work with clients to identify where AI can create advantage, shape AI and data strategy, design scalable operating models, and partner with technical teams to bring priority AI and data science initiatives to life.


 Strategy professionals serve as trusted advisors to our clients, helping them make clear, data\-driven choices about where to play, how to win, and how to scale AI responsibly across the enterprise.
   

  

**Work you will do:**
 Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go\-to\-market strategies, and driving enterprise transformation. As an AI Strategy Consultant, you will:
   

  

* Provide strategic directions to clients on how to leverage Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive innovation, competitive advantage, and enterprise value.
* Work with C\-suite stakeholders to define AI strategy, vision, and transformation roadmaps, aligned to business priorities and market context.
* Identify and prioritize high\-impact AI and GenAI use cases, develop business cases, and define value realization pathways.
* Bring a strong understanding of how AI solutions are developed and deployed in enterprise environments to ground strategic recommendations in practical feasibility.
* Own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle for AI features from problem framing and requirements definition through sprint delivery, UAT, launch, and post\-launch iteration.
* Define detailed product requirements for AI/ML features specifying model inputs/outputs, confidence thresholds, fallback behaviors, latency requirements, and human\-in\-the\-loop escalation paths.
* Understand, decide and communicate business and technical decisions and trade\-offs and decisions to client stakeholders.
* Support clients in shaping AI\-enabled products, services, and business models, including commercialization and go\-to\-market considerations.
* Redesign customer and operational workflows by embedding AI into business processes and decision\-making.
* Partner with data scientists and ML engineers to define data schemas, feature requirements, and evaluation frameworks; contribute to decisions on model selection, fine\-tuning vs. prompting, and deployment approach.
* Support the planning and execution of AI transformation initiatives by coordinating cross\-functional teams, managing stakeholder alignment, tracking key milestones, and helping drive delivery of business outcomes.


**Required Experience And Skills**
**Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy (AI Strategy)**
* – Experience in defining AI strategies, identifying high\-value use cases, and building value creation roadmaps aligned to business priorities.
* – Ability to translate business problems into AI/GenAI opportunities, including use case identification, feasibility assessment, and ROI estimation.
* – Exposure to GenAI concepts (e.g., LLMs, copilots, intelligent automation) and their application across business functions.
* \- Understanding data foundations required for scalable AI adoption, AI/ML algorithm development workflow and data analysis, time\-series analysis, computer vision with an emphasis on generative AI and Large Language Models
* – Experience owning AI\-powered features end\-to\-end, including writing PRDs for ML systems, managing AI product backlogs, and coordinating delivery across product, engineering, and data science.
* – Experience supporting technology, data, analytics, automation, or AI\-enabled initiatives in a professional setting, with the ability to apply this understanding to real\-world enterprise constraints, delivery considerations, and change adoption.


**Core Consulting**
* Clear and concise communication \- conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations.
* Lead product discovery sessions, write and refine requirements with engineering, run sprint reviews, and communicate AI system behavior and limitations to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members.
* Analytical thinking \- ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.
* Logical structuring \- structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems.
* Deadline\-oriented and quality focused \- develop and own development of deliverables. own and manage specific work\-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources.
* Collaboration \- Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate.
* Networking \- Ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.


**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* MBA from a premier institution in India or abroad
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.Tech), preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines
* 4\+ years (for Senior Consultants) of relevant experience in roles involving AI strategy, AI product management, AI\-enabled digital transformation, data \& AI initiatives, or enterprise programs focused on leveraging Artificial Intelligence (including Generative AI) to drive business value
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills
* Ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, data scientists, AI engineers, and product teams.


**Preferred:**
* Prior consulting, strategy, transformation, product management, or technology advisory experience
* Exposure to AI strategy, Generative AI, AI operating models, AI governance, AI product development, or AI transformation programs
* Experience working with global stakeholders and cross\-functional teams
* Familiarity with cloud, data, analytics, and AI ecosystems (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Relevant certifications in AI, Data, Cloud, or Analytics (e.g., Azure AI Fundamentals, Azure Data Fundamentals, AWS AI/ML certifications, Google Cloud AI certifications, Power BI, Tableau, TOGAF, or equivalent)


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**

title: Atlassian Platform Owner
description:
**Job title** 
 :
 **Atlassian Platform Owner**
* Location: Hyderabad


**About Opella**
 Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) \& Vitamins, Minerals \& Supplements (VMS) market globally. Our mission is to bring health in people' s hands by making self\-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.
   

  

 Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world' s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan. B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.
   

  

**About The Job**
 As an Atlassian Platform Owner at Opella, you'll lead platform strategy, governance, reliability and adoption across Jira, Confluence and related apps. You will blend platform product management, agile enablement and vendor/financial stewardship while partnering with Admins, Coaches, Security and Business stakeholders.
   

  

 The Atlassian Platform Owner leads the vision, roadmap, and day\-to\-day operations of the Atlassian platform to enable modern, data\-driven delivery practices across the organization. Partnering with Agile Coaches, Atlassian Administrators, Engineering, Security, Compliance, and Business leaders, the Platform Owner ensures the platform is stable, scalable, secure, and aligned to agile best practices and business outcomes.
   

  

**Our Team**
 As an Atlassian Administrator at Opella, you'll play a crucial role in our Enabling Platforms \& DevOps team, delivering solutions that support our global operations. You'll be at the forefront of implementing and optimizing our Atlassian Cloud portfolio products and integration with marketplace apps and custom solutions, while also bridging the gap between development and project management.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
 As an Atlassian Platform Owner at Opella, you'll lead platform strategy, governance, reliability and adoption across Jira, Confluence and related apps. You will blend platform product management, agile enablement and vendor/financial stewardship while partnering with Admins, Coaches, Security and Business stakeholders.
   

  

 The Atlassian Platform Owner leads the vision, roadmap, and day\-to\-day operations of the Atlassian platform to enable modern, data\-driven delivery practices across the organization. Partnering with Agile Coaches, Atlassian Administrators, Engineering, Security, Compliance, and Business leaders, the Platform Owner ensures the platform is stable, scalable, secure, and aligned to agile best practices and business outcomes.
   

  

**Platform Strategy \& Roadmap**
* Define and maintain the Atlassian platform vision, strategy, and multi\-quarter roadmap, aligning to organizational priorities and agile practices.
* Ensure alignment of the platform with agile best practices and team workflows to optimize productivity, transparency, and collaboration.
* Track and analyze platform performance, adoption, and value metrics; identify improvement areas and drive strategic enhancements.


**Operations, Reliability \& Upgrades**
* Oversee and manage the Atlassian platform (Jira, Confluence, and related services) as a product, ensuring availability, scalability, and strong user experience.
* Manage platform upgrades, configuration baselines, maintenance windows, and release/change calendars; communicate change impacts effectively.
* Coordinate incident response, problem management, and root cause analysis with support teams; maintain runbooks and SLAs.


**Governance, Compliance \& Security**
* Establish and maintain governance for usage, project/site standards, naming conventions, workflows, fields, and permission models.
* Implement data lifecycle policies, backup/restore patterns, content retention, and access controls in partnership with Security and Compliance.
* Ensure compliance requirements (e.g., GxP in Consumer Healthcare contexts) are enforced through process, validation, documentation, and controls.


**Vendor, Licensing \& Budget Management**
* Act as the primary point of contact for Atlassian vendor management: contracts, renewals, usage reviews, performance monitoring, and escalations.
* Manage marketplace apps portfolio (e.g., ScriptRunner, Xray, Comala, draw.io, Snapshots, Guard, Compass, Loom) including value assessments and lifecycle decisions.
* Monitor budget and expenditures for licenses, apps, and operations; forecast demand, right\-size plans, and optimize costs.


**Partnerships \& Stakeholder Management**
* Act as the primary point of contact for Sanofi counterparts, ensuring bidirectional alignment on policies, integrations, and governance.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand requirements and continuously improve the platform to meet evolving business needs.
* Partner closely with Agile Coaches and the Atlassian Administrator(s) to balance configuration agility with platform stability and standards.


**Integrations, Automation \& Extensibility**
* Oversee design and quality of integrations (Forge apps, REST APIs, enterprise systems) ensuring reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Guide adoption of automation to eliminate manual tasks, standardize workflows, and improve data quality and reporting.
* Evaluate and govern custom solutions for sustainability, documentation, and support readiness.


**Enablement, Training \& Adoption**
* Lead training and onboarding programs to ensure teams leverage Jira/Confluence effectively for Scrum, Kanban, and scaled practices.
* Curate templates, playbooks, dashboards, and guidance that support consistent, simple, and value\-focused usage.
* Promote the platform as the system of record for delivery, replacing manual reporting with automated, real\-time insights.


**About You**
**Technical Background**
* 5\+ years owning or administering Atlassian Cloud platforms at scale, including Jira Software and Confluence.
* Deep knowledge of workflows, issue types, fields, schemes, permission models, boards, dashboards, Advanced Roadmaps (Plans), and release management.
* Hands\-on experience with automation (native Automation, ScriptRunner), JQL, and reporting; comfortable guiding admins on best\-practice configurations.
* Experience integrating Atlassian with enterprise systems (via Forge, REST APIs, and standardized integration patterns).
* Familiarity with marketplace apps such as Xray, Comala Document Management, diagrams.net, Guard, Compass, and Snapshots.
* Understanding of agile practices (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and how to operationalize them within Jira/Confluence.
* Awareness of compliance frameworks (e.g., GxP in Consumer Healthcare), data protection, and audit requirements as applied to Atlassian Cloud.
* Atlassian certifications (ACP) and/or Scrum/Agile certifications.


**Soft Skills**
* Strategic product mindset: able to define vision, prioritize roadmaps, and measure value realization.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management; influences from teams to executives.
* Change leadership: drives adoption, simplifies complexity, and replaces manual reporting with data\-driven practices.
* Structured, pragmatic problem\-solver; balances standardization with team autonomy.
* Customer\-centric, hands\-on when needed, and comfortable in a fast\-paced environment.


**Why us?**
 At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day.
   

  

**We Are Challengers.**
 We Are Dedicated To Making Self\-care As Simple As It Should Be. That Starts With Our Culture. We Are Challengers By Nature, And This Is How We Do Things
   

  

* All In Together: We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
* Courageous: We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.
* Outcome\-Obsessed: We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity.
* Radically Simple: We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be.


 Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands.

title: Manager, IT Delivery
description:
**About Vanguard**
 Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
   

  

**Vanguard India**
 Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud\-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world\-class experience for our clients.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Manager, IT Delivery is responsible for leading high\-performing data and technology teams and delivering strategic data initiatives that generate measurable business value.
   

  

 This role combines people leadership, product delivery, stakeholder management, and operational oversight. The manager will lead teams operating across data engineering, data platforms, data warehousing, data lakes, data governance, data quality, and analytics.
   

  

 The manager will have end\-to\-end accountability for the development, delivery, maintenance, production support, reliability, and continuous improvement of data products. The successful candidate will bring strong leadership and communication capabilities, experience managing product\-oriented teams, and a sound understanding of modern data ecosystems. The role requires the ability to translate business priorities into executable delivery plans, develop engineering talent, manage delivery commitments, and ensure the scalability, quality, security, and reliability of data solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead, coach, and develop high\-performing data and technology teams, including hiring, performance management, workforce planning, and talent development.
* Drive delivery of strategic initiatives across data engineering, data warehousing, data lakes / lakehouses, data integration, data governance, data quality, analytics, and business intelligence.
* Partner with business, product, architecture, and engineering stakeholders to translate priorities into product roadmaps, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Lead product\-oriented teams with end\-to\-end accountability for the development, delivery, maintenance, production support, reliability, and continuous improvement of data products.
* Drive Agile practices, including intake management, backlog prioritization, estimation, sprint and release planning, and delivery governance.
* Manage capacity planning, resource forecasting, delivery commitments, risks, issues, and cross\-team dependencies to enable predictable execution.
* Ensure data solutions are scalable, secure, reliable, reusable, and compliant with applicable technology, risk, privacy, and information security standards.
* Promote effective data governance, data quality, metadata management, lineage, ownership, and stewardship practices.
* Monitor delivery, quality, and operational health through relevant metrics, and provide clear, concise updates to stakeholders and leadership.

title: IT Program Project Delivery - Senior Manager
description:
****Who We Are Looking For:****
* The Compliance Technology Project Manager role plays a key role in managing projects across Compliance Technology projects.
* AML Sanctions Screening, AML Transaction Monitoring, and KYC suite of applications.
* We are looking for someone who has proven experience with managing multiple projects consisting of complex applications using globally distributed, cross\-functional teams.
* The role will be responsible for a variety project management of tasks related to Agile Kanban software development lifecycle, management, and reporting under the direction of the Program Managers in Compliance Technology.


****Why This Role Is Important To Us:****
 Compliance Technology partners with Financial Crime Compliance as a critical part of the company because it protects the firm from regulatory and reputational risk while enabling safe business growth and client trust. It’s also a high\-impact area to work in because it combines real\-world problem solving (financial crime) with cutting\-edge innovation in AI, data, and enterprise platforms, offering strong visibility and career growth.
   

  

****What You Will Be Responsible For As Compliance Tech:****
* As a Project Manager you will Collaborate with Program Manager(s) in rolling\-out projects assigned to application team(s).
* Maintain the Screening Demand Backlog including demand prioritization, Schedule Matrix, linkages to Clarity, Financial Crimes Compliance (FCC) AML Screening Roadmap, and other tools as appropriate.
* Maintain Resource allocations against a maintained list of timekeeping tasks, and track actuals against these tasks for one or more projects, as assigned in Clarity.
* Maintain list of timekeeping tasks in Clarity identifying which activities are deferrable and which are not.
* Manage SOP98 Deferrable workflows in Clarity including Statements of Works (SOWs): annual updates, as costs change, as well as monthly tracking against targets for resources and fixed price contracts.
* Responsible for estimating each project.
* Responsible for resource forecasts in Clarity.
* Responsible for reviewing resource time actuals and resolving inconsistencies in Clarity.
* Build, monitor and maintain project plans in Clarity including tasks, dates, dependencies/predecessors, owners, etc.
* Build, monitor, and maintain the various project teams’ work items in Jira Agile Kanban boards.
* Perform role as Kanban Scrum Master as specified by the Agile Office.
* Record, distribute and follow\-up on notes and action items for meetings, as needed (project coordinator may assist in this activity).
* Support all aspects of Status Reporting within Clarity.
* Support risk \& issue tracking and maintenance in Clarity.
* Support, maintain, follow\-up and update SDLC tollgate processes for all assigned projects using Jira and Microsoft Teams. Project coordinator may support this activity, but it is the PM’s responsibility to review and ensure tollgates are completed and closed per SDLC Governance guidelines and training.
* Responsible for procurement management including procurement requests, contract review, approvals, requisitions, invoice approvals, and change orders.
* Maintain a list of all procurement requests including vendor SOWs, software and hardware requests, and annual maintenance renewals.
* Responsible for managing the Third\-Party Risk Management (TPRM) process for each vendor engagement including Inherent Risk Questionnaire (IRQ).
* Ensure Information Security Risk Management Process (ISRMP) is updated as needed for each application.
* Support the Project Management Office (PMO) in providing timely updates as directed.
* Ensure a Data Steward is assigned, and that Data Governance and Data Privacy guidelines are completed by the team when data is involved.
* Work with business partners in prioritizing deliverables.
* Manage the IT budget for programs/projects—both during the budget cycle as well as throughout project execution.
* Manage the change control process for designated projects.
* Maintain Resource Tracking worksheet for onboarding and offboarding of resources (employees and contractors).
* Manage time and material (T\&M) and fixed price (FP) vendors in the Beeline tool including onboarding contracts, resources, timesheet approvals, milestone payments, etc.
* Effectively leverage AI tools (Microsoft Copilot), including prompt engineering and generative AI capabilities, to enhance planning, execution, reporting, and decision\-making across the project lifecycle.
* Support training, access and orientation for new team members.
* Build and maintain positive cross\-team relationships.


****These Skills Will Help You Succeed In This Role****
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail – able to move from one task to another efficiently.
* Excellent written and verbal communication (English) skills including.
* Ability to capture key notes and actions items from meetings.
* Proficiency at follow\-up emails, chats, calls and face to face interactions.
* Required to overlap work at Eastern Time zone.
* Ability to work independently on assigned tasks.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and on more than one project at a time.
* Knowledge of system delivery methodologies – Waterfall, Agile, Kanban.
* Competency with Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, SharePoint, Jira, Clarity, Copilot.
* Strong AI literacy, including effective prompt engineering and use of generative AI tools, to enhance productivity, insight generation, and stakeholder communications.
* Ability to leverage data analytics to drive fact\-based decision\-making, performance tracking, and proactive issue identification throughout the project lifecycle.
* Proven experience delivering multiple versions of one or more applications.
* Experience leading a cross\-functional team, including assigning project priorities, communicating status to other managers and mentoring.
* Experience managing on and offshore resources.


****Education \& Preferred Qualifications:****
* Bachelor’s degree with concentration in Engineering, Business or Technology preferred.
* Minimum 10\-14 years’ work experience.
* Two or more years of full\-time experience in an iterative development environment using an iterative Agile\-like methodology, with experience of delivering working software to production through the entire lifecycle.
* Knowledge of Anti\-Money Laundering (AML), Sanctions, Transaction Monitoring, Know Your Customer (KYC), financial securities, and trading principles.
* Team oriented attitude.
* PMP Certification Work Requirement.
* This is an onsite role in Hyderabad (India).


**Are you the right candidate? Yes!**
 We truly believe in the power that comes from the diverse backgrounds and experiences our employees bring with them. Although each vacancy details what we are looking for, we don’t necessarily need you to fulfil all of them when applying. If you like change and innovation, seek to see the bigger picture, make data driven decisions and are a good team player, you could be a great fit.
   

  

****Why This Role Is Important To Us:****
 Our technology function, Global Technology Services (GTS), is vital to State Street and is the key enabler for our business to deliver data and insights to our clients. We’re driving the company’s digital transformation and expanding business capabilities using industry best practices and advanced technologies such as cloud, artificial intelligence and robotics process automation.
   

  

 We offer a collaborative environment where technology skills and innovation are valued in a global organization. We’re looking for top technical talent to join our team and deliver creative technology solutions that help us become an end\-to\-end, next\-generation financial services company.
   

  

 Join us if you want to grow your technical skills, solve real problems and make your mark on our industry.
   

  

****About State Street****
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

description:
Your opportunity
   

  

 At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
   

  

 Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Prototype, validate and create specific application solutions for the business.
* Assist in execution of development pipeline and delivery of the organization’s software products to QA, and ultimately to Production.
* Interface with product owner and key stakeholders in Project Management, Business, QA and Technology Operations to ensure high quality delivery of software projects on time and budget.
* Identify technology risks and dependencies early to establish mitigation plans.
* Create artifacts for each project such as Software Architecture documentation, Technical Use Cases, and Code Review Packages.
* Meet periodically with onshore and offshore developers to review and improve code quality, requirements specification and design methodologies.
* Utilize automated software test tools and frameworks such as test driven development to achieve software quality standards.
* Build automation frameworks to increase reuse and reduce effort.
* Increase automation cycle execution run times and decrease manual analysis of results.
* Support integration efforts to build whole systems from various subsystems.
* Support release manager to assemble releases and drive improvements in the release process.


 What you have
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or similar/equivalent area of study.
* Minimum of 1\-2 years of solid development experience in PEGA / Java / Spring.
* Experience in building enterprise scale web solutions based upon n\-tier architecture using open source technologies (Angular / React), and SQL / No\-SQL Databases.
* Experience in object oriented design, SOA, design patterns, development, implementation and maintenance.
* Good understanding of latest Architecture and Development Standards, Guidelines and SOLID principles.
* Experience designing and implementing REST based Web Service API(s) in a transaction processing environment.
* You should be comfortable in a fast\-paced customer focused environment that continually embraces the latest technologies and techniques.
* Thorough understanding of Agile software development methodologies, values, and procedures.
* Self\-motivated as well as creative and efficient in proposing solutions to complex, time\-critical problems.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience developing applications on the PEGA platform is desired.
* Test automation experience using Selenium WebDriver with Cucumber is desired.
* Hands on test automation / framework experience in an Agile development environment.
* Exposure in BDD, TDD or ATDD design techniques.
* Ability to analyze, propose and implement timely, cost effective, quality solutions for all issues or problems within area of responsibility.
* Strong programming, debugging/troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Team player with strong interpersonal, organizational and communications skills.


 What’s in it for you
   

  

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long\-term financial security.
   

  

**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**
* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
* Education assistance for continued learning to help you grow
* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
* Annual reimbursement for health check\-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day\-to\-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Senior Consultant-BS-FSI-Insurance
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Job Description \- Strategy \& Transactions – Strategy (Senior Consultant)** 
**At Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions (S\&T), we don’t just advise \- we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth.** 
**We work with C\-suite executives, Boards, and business leaders to answer the questions that matter most, from navigating complex M\&A and driving digital transformation, to reshaping operating models and unlocking new market opportunities. We are trusted advisors during our clients' most critical, high\-stakes moments.** 
**But we don’t stop at client impact, we are equally passionate about investing in our people. At S\&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands\-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive.** 
**Our capabilities span the full lifecycle of transformation, from Enterprise and Growth Strategy to Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy, end\-to\-end M\&A, valuation and modeling, and performance improvement \& restructuring, to infrastructure \& real estate advisory and sustainability\-driven innovation.** 
**If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real\-world impact, and where your growth matters as much as your clients’, Strategy \& Transactions is your next move.**
**The Team**
 Our Strategy practice brings together several key capabilities that will allow us to architect integrated programs that transform our clients’ businesses, including Corporate \& Business Unit Strategy, Technology Strategy \& Insights, Enterprise Model Design, Enterprise Cloud Strategy and Business Transformation.
   

  

 Strategy professionals will serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data\-driven choices about where to play and how to win, in order to drive growth and enterprise value.
   

  

 We are looking for Consultants for our Enterprise and Growth Strategy practice, with relevant experience in Insurance Industry.
   

  

**Work You Will Do**
 Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go\-to\-market strategies, channel strategies, and pricing strategies.
   

  

* Identify strategies for growth and value creation
* Develop appropriate business models, operating models, and capabilities to support their strategic vision
* Providing service excellence by identifying key client business issues, determining client needs by supplementing the standard assessment techniques and tools with innovative approaches, evaluating, and validating analysis and developing recommendations for the client in the context of the overall engagement
* Contribute to multiple work\-threads of large, complex engagements, with high\-quality deliverables
* Participate in the development and presentation of proposals for business development activities
* Maximize the ROI on technology investments and leverage technology trends to architect future business strategies


**Required Experience And Skills**
**Enterprise and Growth Strategy – FSI – Insurance**
**Strategy\-specific Experience:**
 Following experience would be required as a part of this job role:
   

  

* Insurance: Includes working with Life \& Annuities, Personal Lines, Commercial Insurance, Group, Specialty, Health, Reinsurance, Insurance Brokers sub\-sectors, etc. preferably US markets


**Enterprise and Growth Strategy Financial Services Industry Experience:**
* Hands\-on experience of working in Corporate Strategy or consulting firm catering to leading Insurance companies (minimum 2 years of experience)
* Enterprise and Growth Strategy consulting experience \- Corporate Strategy, Go\-to\-market (GTM) Strategy, Business Unit Growth Strategy, Roadmap Development, Business Model, Capability Assessment, Efficiency Plays, Cost Take\-out, Market Research / Assessment, Business Planning, Business \& Digital Transformation, Vendor Assessment, Operating Model Assessment, etc.) within Insurance Industry
* Ability to articulate leading business issues and trends within the Insurance industry. Interest and knowledge about the current trends in any one of its sectors (Life, Commercial, Personal, Specialty, Reinsurance etc.)
* Demonstrate ability to understand and analyze business issues and leverage technology to solve them
* Preferred experience of engaging in strategic issues with senior\-level clients including C\-Suite executives
* Exposure to working in non\-India geographies (preferably US) and / or interacting with global stakeholders
* Exposure around building dynamic Excel models and macros for market sizing, forecasting, and automation of repetitive analysis and reporting tasks
* Ability to craft structured generative research prompts and use tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude or MS Copilot in Excel/PowerPoint) to streamline research, create slides, synthesize interviews, or simulate models
* Experience in developing and deploying LLM tools to accelerate research, generate summaries, and support slide creation


**Core Consulting Skills**
* Clear and concise communication \- Conduct client interviews, participate in workshops / trainings and present recommendations; strong verbal and written skills are critical
* Good client presence – Interact and build relationships with clients and other team members
* Analytical thinking – Comfortable with managing large data sets, ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary), synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data through configurable dashboards; familiarity with Python, and Excel Macro scripting is nice to have
* Logical structuring \- Structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems
* Deadline\-oriented and quality focused – Support team in development of deliverables, manage specific work\-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources
* Collaboration \- Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate
* Ownership – Take ownership, manage and co\-ordinate activities and tasks assigned and drive to completion
* Network \- ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.


**\#FY27ReferralCampaign**
**Required Qualifications**
**For Consultants:**
* MBA or MS from a premier (Tier\-1\) school in India or abroad (not more than 6 years post MS / MBA)
* 4 to 5 years of relevant experience (post MS / MBA) in Insurance Industry
* Experience in consulting, or corporate strategy environment strongly preferred
* 3\+ years of industry experience with Insurance industry focus (preferably US clients)


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
   

  

**Recruiting tips**
 From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Global Brand HCP Lead
description:
Opella is the self\-care challenger with the purest and third\-largest portfolio in the Over\-The\-Counter (OTC) \& Vitamins, Minerals \& Supplements (VMS) market globally.
 



 Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self\-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.
 



  





 At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000\-strong global team, our 13 best\-in\-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.
 



 B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com.
 



  





 You’ve built experience, now use it where bold ideas meet real impact. At Opella, we’re challenging how self\-care works for millions of people and need leaders and experts ready to shape what’s next. As a Global HCP Lead, you’ll bring your skill, your curiosity and your drive to make health simpler, smarter and more human.
 



  





**About the job :**




  





 We are seeking a dynamic and strategic
 **Global HCP Brand Lead** 
 for Allegra.
 **Allegra** 
 is the
 **world’s leading allergy brand** 
 and a trusted name in respiratory health across the globe. We are committed to helping consumers live their lives fully by providing effective, now\-drowsy allergy solutions that enable them to be at their best.
 



 In this role you will leverage your scientific and commercial acumen to drive short and mid\-term executional HCP excellence, from defining the global HealthCare Professional marketing strategy to building the assets needed for multi\-channel engagement of HCP activation with GPs, ENTs, Pediatricians, Allergists and other members of the medical community in key focus markets and around the globe.
 



* Lead initiatives that advance our brands and strengthen our reputation worldwide.
* Mentor and uplift emerging talent while pushing your own growth and influence.
* Put purpose into practice — embedding sustainability, access and social impact into every decision.
* Model the challenger mindset: question complexity, act with integrity and make things radically simple.
* Help shape a culture that’s ambitious, collaborative and serious about recognition and belonging.



  





**Main Responsibilities** 



* Defines HCP/ MCE engagement strategy in line with overall brand strategy fundamentals and science\-led differentiation and key HCP insights to drive recommendations and prescriptions for Allegra. Ensures alignment with global brand strategy, regulatory requirements and scientific medical support.
* Leverages scientific and commercial acumen to drive short and mid\-term executional HCP excellence as a key pillar and contributor of the overall integrated Allegra marketing and commercial strategy.
* Manages HCP content creation and toolkit deployment from ideation to in\-market delivery and advises markets on content adapted locally. Develops scientific and promotional materials for HCP audiences (e.g., detailing aids, congress materials, digital assets).
* Shares learnings and best practices across markets to raise overall market performance levels in HCP approach and acts as a consultant to the market in their HCP approach and delivery.
* Gathers and analyzes HCP and related consumer insights to inform strategy and content development. Monitors prescription shares and recommendations data and performance metrics and define corrective actions and campaign optimization based on data together with the Zone Brand leads.
* Is critical in driving HCP marketing with Brand marketing, Medical and MCE teams, by providing professional project management support to ensure global project plans are designed and executed in line with planned time, cost and quality.
* Guides teams through the initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and control and close out phases of HCP programs to achieve a successful execution of the HCP Marketing strategy. Collaborates with Science team to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Reporting to the Global Brand General Manager for Allegra, the Global HCP lead collaborates closely with Zone Brand Leads and Zone HCP/MCE Leads in focus markets as well as with Global Medical \& Regulatory, Global Claims Lead, Global Strategy and Content Leads.



  





**About You**




  





**Education** 



* Graduate degree in Marketing, Management degree/MBA (preferable)



  





**Languages** 



* Fluency in English in a professional context spoken and written is a must.



  





**Professional Experience** 



* Relevant Experience in HCP marketing (detailing, conferences and omni\-channel HCP marketing) in the OTC, Health/Wellness, or Healthcare/Pharma sectors is a must. Experience marketing in FMCG or OTC healthcare brands is highly desirable. 5\+ years of senior level marketing and general managerial experience
* Regional experience is desired and Global experience a plus.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strategic thinking: Ability to translate scientific and market insights into actionable global HCP strategies and craft and execute HCP\-centric marketing activation that builds Brands Love.
* Commercial acumen with P\&L management and project ROI judgement.
* Scientific/medical Literacy: Strong ability to understand therapeutic areas and claims and ability to translate into clear, compelling and differentiated messaging.
* Project Management/Prioritization: Skilled in managing multiple projects, timelines, and stakeholders across geographies. Proven adaptability to changing priorities and strategies.
* Collaboration \& Influence: Proven ability to work cross\-functionally and influence without authority with strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Digital Savvy: Knowledge of digital channels and omnichannel engagement for HCPs.
* Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint).

title: Product Manager
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a dynamic, first\-principles\-driven
 **Product Head** 
 to own and scale the Chai Shots app and ecosystem.
   

  

 You will be responsible for envisioning, building, and continuously improving a product loved by millions \- ensuring it is beautifully designed, data\-backed, consumer\-first, and constantly evolving.
   

  

 You will lead product strategy, execution, consumer research, and growth enablement. You will work directly with the founders and will have full ownership to drive product\-market fit, scalability, and innovation.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Own the entire product strategy, roadmap, and user experience.
* Deeply understand consumers \- their emotions, habits, triggers \- through research, data, and instinct.
* Design unforgettable experiences \- from first touch to lifelong engagement.
* Own and craft the end\-to\-end user experience (UX) across the entire app journey \- from onboarding to discovery to engagement to subscription.
* Define the UX vision \- how users flow, feel, and interact with every touchpoint inside the app.
* Use data ruthlessly \- set up systems for analytics, cohort tracking, A/B testing, and continuous iteration.
* Think from first principles \- we don’t believe in copy\-paste product thinking.
* Build and lead a high\-performing product and design team \- hire sharp minds, mentor them, and build a culture of speed and creativity.
* Collaborate across engineering, content, and growth to ship features fast, learn faster.
* Balance art and science \- dream big, execute sharply, measure everything.
* Own the product’s emotional core \- how users feel about Chai Shots must matter to you deeply.


**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

title: Product Manager - Agentic
description:
**About This Role** 



* We are building an agentic banking platform for large enterprise banks. Multi\-modal AI converts business intent into autonomous agents that orchestrate processes, integrate data, and make intelligent decisions — turning weeks of manual work into hours.
* You will lead AI agents and intelligent automation — building capabilities that deploy autonomous agents to solve complex banking problems at enterprise scale.
* This is not a pillar\-specific role. You'll work across three interconnected pillars (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents), collaborating with peer PMs to architect and ship agentic solutions end\-to\-end.
* You'll report directly to the
 **Product Director** 
 and own the complete journey: from defining what agentic capabilities matter most, to shipping them, to measuring their impact.
* This role is for a PM who understands how AI agents fundamentally change enterprise automation, who can navigate technical and business complexity, and who ships with both ambition and rigor.



  





**What You'll Own** 




**Strategic ownership** 



* Define the AI capability roadmap — which features move the needle, which delight customers, which drive competitive advantage
* Make the hard calls: what ships in Year 1, what comes after, what's out of scope
* Own the quality bar — "enterprise grade" means reliable, explainable, compliant, and safe. Set and enforce that standard.
* Shape how AI surfaces across the platform — consistency in UX, tone, and behavior across copilot, solution builder, and other capabilities



  





**Execution leadership** 



* Lead cross\-pillar alignment — work with peer PMs to define integration points and success metrics
* Conduct customer discovery: what AI capabilities matter most, what fears do they have about AI, what use cases are most valuable
* Make data\-driven decisions: usage patterns, LLM cost, inference latency, customer sentiment all inform roadmap
* Unblock ambiguity: when technical feasibility isn't clear (cost, latency, quality), you synthesize information and move forward decisively



  





**Partnership with platform PMs** 



* Collaborate with peer PMs who own the platform pillars
* Establish clear integration contracts: where AI surfaces in their UIs, how data flows from their features to your LLM calls, how they measure success



  





**We're Looking For** 




**Experience shipping one or more of the following:** 




 AI\-native products or features that users love · Enterprise software with AI capabilities built in (not tacked on) · Products that required deep LLM integration and cost optimization · Cross\-functional initiatives that span multiple teams or product areas · Experiences that balance power with usability.
 



  





**Core capabilities** 



* AI fluency, not just enthusiasm – You understand LLM capabilities and limits. You know the difference between a prototype and a production system. You think about cost, latency, hallucination, and compliance from day one.
* Systems thinking across pillars – You see how an AI feature in one pillar impacts the others. You optimize for platform coherence, not local feature wins.
* Customer reality grounding – You spend time with users and understand their AI skepticism. You don't oversell; you deliver reliably.
* Quality obsession – You know that "enterprise grade" is non\-negotiable. Explainability, compliance, reliability, and safety are as important as feature velocity.
* Technical depth without being an engineer – You read research, understand prompt engineering tradeoffs, can discuss model selection and fine\-tuning. You think rigorously about technical problems.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Shipped copilot or AI\-assisted features in a production SaaS product
* Experience with LLM cost optimization, latency budgeting, or inference infrastructure
* Familiarity with enterprise workflow, process automation, or BPM domains
* Track record of shipping cross\-functional initiatives with competing stakeholders

title: Digital Product Manager
